# Testament of Judah — 4
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

**1** The copy of the words of Judah, which he spake to his sons before he died. **2** They gathered themselves together and came to him, and he said to them: **3** Hear, my children, the words of Judah your father, and keep my sayings to do all the righteousness of the Lord, and to obey the commands of God. **4** Walk not after your lusts, nor in the imaginations of your thoughts in haughtiness of heart; and glory not in the deeds and strength of your youth, for this also is evil in the eyes of the Lord. **5** Since I also gloried that in wars no comely woman's face ever enticed me, and reproved Reuben my brother concerning Bilhah, the wife of my father, the spirits of jealousy and of fornication arrayed themselves against me, until I lay with Bathshua the Canaanitess, and Tamar, who was espoused to my sons.

**2** For I said to my father-in-law: I will take counsel with my father, and so will I take thy daughter. **2** And he was unwilling, but he shewed me a boundless store of gold in his daughter's behalf; for he was a king. **3** And he adorned her with gold and pearls, and caused her to pour out wine for us at the feast with the beauty of women. **4** And the wine turned aside my eyes, and pleasure blinded my heart. **5** And I became enamoured of her, and I lay with her, and I transgressed the commandment of the Lord and the commandment of my fathers, and I took her to wife. **6** And the Lord rewarded me according to the imagination of my heart, inasmuch as I had no joy from her children.

**3** And now I charge you, my children, hearken to Judah your father, and keep my sayings to do all the righteousness of the Lord, and to obey the command of God. **2** And walk not after your lusts, nor in the imaginations of your thoughts in haughtiness of heart; and glory not in the deeds and strength of your youth. **3** For even I gloried that in wars no comely woman's face ever enticed me, and I reproved Reuben my brother concerning Bilhah, the wife of my father. **4** But the spirit of jealousy and fornication arrayed themselves against me, until I lay with Bathshua the Canaanitess, and Tamar, who was espoused to my sons.

**4** For I said to my father-in-law: I will take counsel with my father, and so will I take thy daughter. **2** And he was unwilling; but shewed me a boundless store of gold in his daughter's behalf. **3** And he adorned her with gold and pearls, and caused her to pour out wine for us at the feast with the beauty of women. **4** And the wine turned aside mine eyes, and pleasure blinded my heart. **5** And I became enamoured of her and I lay with her, and I transgressed the commandment of the Lord and the commandment of my fathers, and I took her to wife.

**5** For my father had no joy from her children. **2** But after she died, with a grieved heart I knew that I had sinned in taking her; for she was from the daughters of Canaan. **3** For I saw concerning her in a vision of the night, that the kingdom of the Lord shall not be established through her. **4** And now, my children, I say unto you, be not drunk with wine; for wine turneth the mind away from the truth, and inspireth the passion of lust, and leadeth the eyes into error.

**6** For the spirit of fornication hath wine as a minister to give pleasure to the mind; for these two also take away the power of a man. **2** For if a man drink wine to drunkenness, it disturbeth the mind with filthy thoughts leading to fornication, and heateth the body to carnal union; and if the occasion of the lust be present, he worketh the sin, and is not ashamed. **3** Such is the inebriated man, my children; for he who is drunken reverenceth no man. **4** For lo, it made me err so that I was not ashamed of the multitude in the city, in that before the eyes of all I turned aside to Tamar, and I wrought a great sin, and I uncovered the covering of my sons' shame.

**7** After drinking wine I had no fear of God, and I did not remember the commandment of my father, and I went in to her. **2** For they who are not drunk with wine, who have the fear of God, do not commit fornication. **3** But the man who is drunk with wine honoureth no man; for if the passion of fornication attack him, he acteth shamefully, and he is not afraid of anyone.

**8** And now, my children, I command you, love not money, nor gaze on the beauty of women; because for the sake of money and beauty I was led astray to Bathshua the Canaanitess. **2** For I know that because of these two things shall my seed fall into wickedness. **3** For even the wise among my sons shall they make to err, and shall cause the kingdom of Judah to be diminished, which the Lord gave me because of my obedience to my father. **4** For I never caused grief to my father Jacob; for all things whatsoever he commanded me I did. **5** And Isaac, the father of my father, blessed me to be king in Israel, and Jacob further blessed me in like manner.

**9** And I know that from me shall the kingdom be established. **2** And I have read in the books of Enoch the righteous what evils ye will do in the last days. **3** Take heed, therefore, my children, of fornication, and the love of money, and hearken to Judah your father. **4** For these things withdraw you from the law of God, and blind the inclination of the soul, and teach arrogance, and suffer not a man to have compassion upon his neighbour. **5** They rob his soul of all goodness, and oppress him with toils and troubles, and drive away sleep from him, and devour his flesh. **6** And he hindereth the sacrifices of God; and he remembereth not the blessing of God, and hearkeneth not to a prophet when he speaketh, and resenteth the words of godliness. **7** For he is enslaved to two contrary passions, and cannot obey God, because they have blinded his soul, and he walketh in the day as in the night.

**10** But keep the commandments of the Lord, my children, and honour Levi, that ye may dwell safely, for from Levi salvation shall arise for Israel. **2** For the Lord shall appear among men saving every race of Israel. **3** For the Lord shall bless Levi, and Judah shall be glorified. **4** For the Lord shall raise up from Levi as it were a High-priest, and from Judah as it were a King, God and man; He shall save all the Gentiles and the race of Israel.

---
*End of Testament of Judah*
